import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from controller import run
rng=random.Random(303)
def mk(J,S,F,G,chain=False,targets=None):
    times=list(range(0,S*3,3))
    slots=[[t,512,0 if i==0 else 512] for i,t in enumerate(times)]
    groups=[]
    for g in range(G):
        groups.append([(-1 if g==0 else (g-1 if chain else rng.randrange(g))), 512])
    flows=[]
    for f in range(F):
        t = targets[f] if targets else rng.randint(1,64)
        flows.append([t, 512, -1 if rng.random()<0.2 else rng.randrange(G), rng.randrange(7)])
    windows=[[rng.randrange(F), 0, 10**12, rng.randint(1,65535), rng.randint(1,320), 0, rng.randint(1,1000),
              [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)] ] for _ in range(J)]
    return {'model':'cnn','class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            'stats':[rng.randint(1,200),rng.randint(1,200),rng.randint(1,300)],
            'bucket':[512,512],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows}
def timed(name,cases):
    raw=json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':cases}).encode()
    t0=time.time(); out=run(raw); print('%-34s %.2fs %s'%(name, time.time()-t0,[r['ratio'] for r in out['results']])); sys.stdout.flush()
timed('diverse targets 512w',[mk(512,256,32,32,targets=[rng.randint(1,64) for _ in range(32)])])
timed('all t=64 512w',[mk(512,256,32,32,targets=[64]*32)])
timed('chain groups 512w',[mk(512,256,32,32,chain=True)])
timed('2x diverse',[mk(512,256,32,32,targets=[rng.randint(1,64) for _ in range(32)]) for _ in range(2)])
